scope: scripts/test_vci_host_mcp.py on the Release Host with real Git: 72 stdio checks across several Host lifetimes. Every VCI response validates against its JSON contract; exact BOM/CRLF/binary/Unicode bytes, empty files, explicit deletion, parent history, branches, package capture/compare, old-revision materialization, wrong/stale review refusal, an owned Host interruption after the durable dispatch callback, fresh-Host replay refusal and receipt-only reconciliation.
limitations: Host-only: native engineering and simulator workers are deliberately absent; no TIA Portal, Openness, PLCSIM or device is involved and none is qualified.
Synthetic and independently authored fixtures on PCNico only; no customer project, Siemens-exported document corpus, scale limit beyond the runner's bounds or other Host build is qualified.
No native VCI workspace, mapping, export/import, project reconstruction or remote Git publication.
